references.text: Shaving of the head as part of a purification rite, where the Nazirite shaves his consecrated head when he becomes unclean
Shaving and cleansing as part of the purification ritual for lepers, including shaving all hair
Shaving of the head as a sign of humiliation and mourning, used symbolically regarding Assyria as God's instrument
Shaving of the head as a sign of grief and lament over destruction
Prohibition against shaving the forehead for the dead, showing the contrast to the permitted practice for prisoners of war
Joseph shaved himself and changed his clothes before entering Pharaoh's presence, similar preparation and transition to a new status
